issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: iron_bars, red_wall_banner.
170 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Adds iron-bar windows, a red banner over the door and torches beside it; the side faces are still bare.
notes.life: Torches by the door count as light; still no plants.

visual.summary: L1 plus iron-bar windows, a red wall banner over the town-side door and door torches; visibly more finished than L1.
problems: Same narrow west walk entrance as L1: (0,5,2) and (0,6,2) are solid, so the walk is 1 wide where it enters from the west.
Reachability: fine - 50 of 51 reached; only (1,5,3) beside the stair is not.

notes.detail: Capped at 1 by the levels rule: L2 adds only small decoration (iron bars in the slits, a red banner and two torches on the town door, a lantern and a barrel on the platform).
notes.levels: From the field side (front, iso), L2 can hardly be told from L1: the only change is the iron bars. The banner shows only from the town side.
notes.artefacts: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone. Torch on iron bars at (3,6,2) won't hold. A lantern stands on the top stair step at (2,8,3), right in the roof hatch.
notes.roof: Same crenellated platform as L1; the roof warning is the usual flat-top one.

visual.summary: Level 2: L1 plus iron bars in the arrow slits, a red banner and two torches on the town-side door, and a lantern and a barrel on the archer platform.
problems: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone.

L2 needs one clearly visible new feature over L1, seen from the front too, e.g. hoarding brackets, a machicolation row on the corbels, a flag on the platform or a brazier. Right now the change is only small props.
Wall torch at (3,6,2) facing south hangs on the iron bars at (3,6,1): iron bars have no solid face, so in game the torch drops. Move it beside the window onto (2,6,1) or (4,6,1).
The lantern at (2,8,3) stands on the top stair step (2,7,3), where soldiers come out of the stair hatch. Move it to a merlon corner, e.g. on top of (1,8,3).

Joining: the 7 x 7 box puts the tower walls at x1..5 and z1..5, so x0 and x6 are empty from y0 to y8. Placed box to box beside stone_wall_straight v2 (3 deep: parapet z0, 2-wide walk z1-2 with floor at y4), this leaves a 1-block air gap at x0 and x6 with no walk floor, and the tower's walk (z2-3) sits 1 block behind the wall's walk (z1-2). Either fill x0/x6 with the wall profile (floor (0,4,2..3) and (6,4,2..3), parapet at z1), or state the (-1,-1) placement offset in the meta so the layout overlaps the empty ring.
Reachability: fine. 70 of 71 standing places are reached (only (2,5,4) beside the stair is not); soldiers get around the lantern by way of (1,7,4).

notes.artefacts: Last round's problems are fixed. The front torch is gone, and the iron bars at (3,6,1) now sit in an empty window. The platform lantern moved off the stair exit to (4,8,2), so (2,8,3) is clear. The hanging lantern (3,6,0) has the gallery planks (3,7,0) above it. The banners (2,5,0)/(4,5,0)/(3,4,6) and the door torches (2,2,6)/(4,2,6) all hang on solid stone.
notes.levels: The timber hoarding on the front (dark oak brackets at y6, a planked gallery at y7 z0 with a spruce fence railing) plus the red banners stand out clearly in the front and iso views. This is a real new feature over L1, not just props.
notes.roof: The top is crenellated and the timber hoarding rail adds a second material. The roof-overhang warning is the usual one for wall pieces.
notes.life: Lanterns and banners, but no plants yet.

visual.summary: L2 adds a timber hoarding on the front (gallery on dark oak brackets with a fence railing), red banners on both faces, iron bars in the slits, torches flanking the door and a lantern over the slit.
problems: Minor: the hoarding is only 1 deep, with the planks (1..5,7,0) and the fence railing on the same row (1..5,8,0), so there is no room to stand on it. It reads fine as a hoarding from outside. If it is meant to be used, push the railing out to z-1 or open the crenels behind it.
Minor: the iron bars in the side windows (1,2,3) and (5,2,3) look straight into the solid wall body at (0,2,3)/(6,2,3), so they are blind. Fill them or move them to z4.
Joining matches stone_wall_straight_l2 v2 block for block (profile at x0/x6, walk floor y4, headroom y5-6). Fixed.
Reachability: fine. 72 of 73 standing places are reached; only (2,5,4) beside the stair is not.
